class.name: FellowWorldStreamer3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: keeps the [FellowStreamingCell3D] nodes below it loaded around the camera.
class.description: Every frame the streamer measures the distance from the viewport's camera (with [member use_camera]), its [member targets] and the [method prefetch] points to each cell's box. Cells within their load distance are requested from the [ResourceLoader]'s threads (the nearest first, at most [member max_loading] loading or being instantiated at once), instantiated on a worker thread ([member threaded_instancing]) and added to the tree, at most [member max_activations_per_frame] a frame; loaded cells beyond the distance plus [member unload_margin] are freed, the farthest first, at most [member max_releases_per_frame] a frame. With [member streaming] off every cell loads (the whole level resident). With FellowEngine's texture streaming ([code]rendering/fellow/streaming/textures[/code]) the cells' textures load with only their small mips. See [code]docs/decisions/0147-world-streaming.md[/code].

method.name: get_stats
method.description: The cells by state, loads and releases, failures, the main thread's time adding and removing cells (total and the largest), the worker threads' instantiation time, the time from request to the tree (total and the largest), the streamer's own time, frames, [code]settled[/code].

method.name: is_settled
method.description: Every cell within its distance is in the tree, every cell beyond its distance plus the margin is freed, and nothing is loading.

method.name: load_now
method.description: Loads, instantiates and adds every cell in range at once, on this thread (behind a loading screen); returns how many entered the tree.

method.name: prefetch
method.description: Cells within [param radius] of [param position] (and within the load distance of it) load as if a camera were there: a teleport's destination, before the camera arrives.

method.name: split_into_cells
method.description: Splits [param root]'s 3D children into cells of [param cell_size] metres on this streamer's XZ grid: each cell's nodes are moved into a new scene saved in [param directory] ([code]cell_X_Z.scn[/code]) and replaced by a [FellowStreamingCell3D] under this streamer, placed at the cell's centre with the nodes' bounds; the nodes keep their global transforms when the cell loads. Both nodes must be in the scene tree. Left where they are: nodes of the classes in [code]options["exclude_classes"][/code] (by default [Camera3D], [DirectionalLight3D], [WorldEnvironment] and the streamers and cells themselves) and nodes wider than [code]options["max_span"][/code] cells (2: terrain, large structures). [code]options["load_distance"][/code] sets the cells' load distance (0: the streamer's), [code]options["extension"][/code] the scenes' format ([code]"scn"[/code] or [code]"tscn"[/code]), [code]options["owner"][/code] the new cells' owner (the root's owner by default, so that the editor saves them with the scene). Returns the cells made. The editor's [b]Scene > Split into Streaming Cells[/b] menu calls it on the selected streamer.

members.member: In the editor, every [FellowStreamingCell3D] below the streamer shows its [member FellowStreamingCell3D.scene_path] as an internal child: not in the Scene dock, not saved with the level, and a click on it selects the cell. Off for a world too large to show whole. Nothing in a game.
The distance from a cell's box at which it loads (a cell's own [member FellowStreamingCell3D.load_distance] wins).
Cells added to the tree a frame (each costs the main thread its nodes' entering the tree).
Cells loading or being instantiated at once.
Off: every cell loads, whatever the distance.
Nodes around which cells load, besides the camera (players, vehicles).
A loaded cell's nodes are created on a worker thread (off: on the main thread, when its load finishes).
Hysteresis: a cell is freed only beyond its load distance plus this.
The viewport's current camera is a point around which cells load.
